name: Account Token Tracker
description: Track per-account quota % vs real API dollar value ($/mo), visualize model cost mix, and detect silent quota nerfs week-over-week.

cover.alt: Account Token Tracker sidebar dashboard showing grouped account quota bars, model cost mix, and weekly dollar value drift SVG chart

screenshots.alt: Grouped account cards with quota progress bars, reset countdowns, and color-coded model cost stacked bars in dark and light themes
screenshots.caption: Account Overview & Model Cost Mix (Dark & Light Themes)

screenshots.alt: Weekly and monthly SVG drift charts tracking estimated monthly dollar value against baseline and -15% alert threshold
screenshots.caption: Weekly & Monthly Value Drift Watch (Enshittification Detection)

screenshots.alt: Expandable percentage jump ledger with per-model Input, Output, and Cache token breakdown and automatic outlier exclusion badges
screenshots.caption: Expandable % Jump Ledger & Automatic Outlier Guard

statusBarItems.tooltip: 계정별 쿼터 % 대비 모델별 API 환산 가치($/월 · $/1%) 감시 (클릭하여 새로고침)

settings.title: Polling interval (seconds)
settings.description: How often to sample account rate limits and incremental local usage logs.

settings.title: Maximum raw ledger entries
settings.description: Number of individual percentage-jump records to keep (weekly/monthly rollups are kept permanently).

settings.title: Value drop alert threshold (%)
settings.description: Flag a warning when weekly/monthly estimated $/mo value drops by at least this percentage compared to your baseline period.

settings.title: Custom model pricing overrides (JSON)
settings.description: Optional JSON map of model ID to USD per 1M tokens, e.g. {"claude-opus-5-5":{"input":5,"output":25}}.
